name: VIA University College
about: VIA is a university college (professionshøjskole) in central and western Jutland, and it teaches a range of first degrees in English. Most are in Horsens: engineering, software and construction management, taught as applied degrees with a 20-week internship. Viborg has The Animation Workshop, whose three talent-based animation and illustration degrees admit on a portfolio and an admission test, plus a software degree specialising in XR. Herning has a two-year AP degree in design, technology and business.

languageOfInstruction.note: VIA teaches most of its programmes in Danish. The English-taught ones are listed separately on en.via.dk.

sources.title: VIA's list of English-taught bachelor's and AP degree programmes, and its statement that bachelor's degrees at university colleges are professional bachelor's degrees.
sources.quote: We offer English taught bachelor's and AP degree programmes in animation, construction, design, engineering and business! [...] Bachelor's degrees at University Colleges are called Professional Bachelor's degrees and generally have a stronger emphasis on practice.

sources.title: Every VIA English-taught programme needs English at Danish B level with a weighted average of at least 2.0, or an accepted test (IELTS Academic 6.5, TOEFL iBT 94 before 21 January 2026 or 4.5 after, Cambridge C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency at 180). A test cannot replace English where it is a specific entry requirement.
sources.quote: To meet the English proficiency requirement through your Upper Secondary School you must document that your English proficiency can be equated to a Danish B-level with a minimum weighted grade point average score of 2.0 on the Danish grading scale. [...] IELTS (Academic) with a minimum average score of 6.5 [...] TOEFL (iBT), Internet-based with a score of at least 94 for tests taken before 21 January 2026. TOEFL tests taken after 21 January 2026 with a minimum score of 4.5. [...] An English proficiency test cannot replace English as a specific entry requirement which some study programmes require.

notes: Each VIA programme page says every specific subject must be passed with a minimum average of 2.0 on the Danish scale. Applicants with non-Danish qualifications are asked for a verification form, stamped by their school, that confirms the hours taught in each required subject over the last three years.

The English-proficiency rule is shared across VIA: English at Danish B level with a weighted average of at least 2.0, or an accepted test such as IELTS Academic 6.5. A test cannot replace English where a programme names it as a specific requirement.

Software Technology Engineering, Cybersecurity specialisation (Horsens) is not listed here. Its first intake is February 2028 ("Apply in 2027 for study start in February 2028"), so it has no autumn 2027 place.

Branding and Marketing Management and Fashion Design appear in VIA's list as AP degrees. They are the two specialisations of Design, Technology and Business, chosen when you apply, so this site shows them as that one programme.
The Animation Workshop pages redirect from en.via.dk to animationworkshop.via.dk, and its application steps only appear in a browser.
VIA teaches in Danish on its other campuses (Aarhus among them). Only the three campuses with an English-taught first degree are listed here.

requirements.label: An IB Diploma, or DP Course Results with at least 18 points, grade 3 in all six subjects and three of them at HL

officialWording.text: IB-elever uden IB Diploma, men med mindst 18 point (Diploma Programme (DP) Course Results), har adgang til videregående uddannelser i Danmark på lige vilkår med ansøgere med den 2-årige hf-eksamen uden overbygning. Det kræver, at alle 6 IB-fag (3 HL-fag og 3 SL- eller 4 HL-fag og 2 SL-fag) er bestået med mindst karakteren 3. Det betyder, at de har adgang til at søge optagelse på erhvervsakademi- og professionsbacheloruddannelser gennem kvote 1 og 2.

requirements.note: The rule is national, not this institution's. The Danish Agency for Higher Education and Science treats DP Course Results of at least 18 points, with grade 3 or more in all six subjects and three at HL, like a two-year hf without overbygning, which gives access to erhvervsakademi and professionsbachelor programmes through quota 1 and quota 2. This is a professionsbachelor programme, which the Agency names directly. The institution's own page names the IB but says nothing about Course Results, so a Course candidate should confirm with admissions in writing. The award does not waive the subject requirements below.

sources.title: DP Course Results (formerly the IB Certificate) of at least 18 points, with at least grade 3 in all six subjects and at least three subjects at HL, are a qualifying examination in Denmark on the same terms as a two-year hf without overbygning: they give access to erhvervsakademi- and professionsbachelor programmes through quota 1 and quota 2, and to a university bachelor only after two successive raises of upper-secondary subject level, at least one to A level, taken as hf-enkeltfag. Course Results under 18 points, or containing any subject at grade 1 or 2, are not a qualifying examination at all. A full IB Diploma of 24 points or more gives access to every higher education programme in Denmark.

programmes.name: Character Animation

sources.title: Character Animation (Viborg) is a bachelor of 3 years 3 months, starting in August and admitting once a year. Admission is talent-based and every applicant takes an admissions test.
sources.quote: Type and duration Bachelor (3 years 3 months) Study start and city August, Viborg Application deadline March 15, 12 noon Admissions frequency Once every year [...] Admission to the programme is talent-based We are looking for students with excellent drawing and storytelling skills. Therefore, all applicants must complete an admissions test to show whether they qualify for enrolment. [...] Students from the EU and EEA countries study are exempt from paying tuition fees in Denmark.

programmes.about: Animating characters in 2D and 3D at The Animation Workshop in Viborg, with film-making projects alongside Computer Graphic Arts students and a 10-week studio internship. It lasts 3 years and 3 months, and admission is decided on talent: a portfolio, an admission test and an interview.

admission.capacityNote: 26 admitted from 368 applicants in 2025, according to The Animation Workshop.

selection.description: The portfolio is assessed on how well it meets the programme's portfolio requirements, skill level in the relevant categories, creative vision, and how clearly the work is curated and presented.

sources.title: A portfolio in one PDF, a filled-in cover letter and a video introduction are uploaded to optagelse.dk by 15 March at 12:00 noon, and are assessed against the programme's portfolio requirements.
sources.quote: Your portfolio must contain: A filled in official cover letter An active link to your video introduction, which serves as a motivational letter Examples of your work fulfilling the requirements for the programme [...] Submit your portfolio with your application at optagelse.dk no later than 15 March at 12:00 noon (UTC+1). [...] Late submissions are not accepted.

selection.description: A 4-hour individual online test of small drawing assignments, testing time management, following directions, and drawing and storytelling skills.

sources.title: Invited applicants sit an online admission test (4 hours for Character Animation and CG Arts; a 3.5-hour comics test plus a 1-hour essay for Graphic Storytelling) and a 20 to 25 minute interview, in person in Viborg or online.

officialWording.text: IB-elever uden IB Diploma, men med mindst 18 point (Diploma Programme (DP) Course Results), har adgang til videregående uddannelser i Danmark på lige vilkår med ansøgere med den 2-årige hf-eksamen uden overbygning. Det kræver, at alle 6 IB-fag (3 HL-fag og 3 SL- eller 4 HL-fag og 2 SL-fag) er bestået med mindst karakteren 3. requirements.note: The rule is national, not this institution's. The Danish Agency for Higher Education and Science treats DP Course Results of at least 18 points, with grade 3 or more in all six subjects and three at HL, like a two-year hf without overbygning, which gives access to erhvervsakademi and professionsbachelor programmes through quota 1 and quota 2. This is an erhvervsakademiuddannelse (AP degree), which the Agency names directly. The institution's own page names the IB but says nothing about Course Results, so a Course candidate should confirm with admissions in writing. The award does not waive the subject requirements below.

programmes.about: Comics, graphic novels, illustration and storyboarding for animation and games, at The Animation Workshop in Viborg. It lasts 3 years and 9 months and admits only in odd-numbered years, so 2027 is an intake year. Admission is on a portfolio, a drawing test, an essay and an interview.

sources.title: DP Course Results (formerly the IB Certificate) of at least 18 points, with at least grade 3 in all six subjects and at least three subjects at HL, are a qualifying examination in Denmark on the same terms as a two-year hf without overbygning: they give access to erhvervsakademi- and professionsbachelor programmes through quota 1 and quota 2, and to a university bachelor only after two successive raises of upper-secondary subject level, at least one to A level, taken as hf-enkeltfag. Course Results under 18 points, or containing any subject at grade 1 or 2, are not a qualifying examination at all. A full IB Diploma of 24 points or more gives access to every higher education programme in Denmark.
sources.quote: IB-elever uden IB Diploma, men med mindst 18 point (Diploma Programme (DP) Course Results), har adgang til videregående uddannelser i Danmark på lige vilkår med ansøgere med den 2-årige hf-eksamen uden overbygning. Det kræver, at alle 6 IB-fag (3 HL-fag og 3 SL- eller 4 HL-fag og 2 SL-fag) er bestået med mindst karakteren 3. Det betyder, at de har adgang til at søge optagelse på erhvervsakademi- og professionsbacheloruddannelser gennem kvote 1 og 2. Ansøgere med et Diploma Programme (DP) Course Results på mindst 18 point og mindst karakteren 3 i alle fag kan derudover få adgang til en universitetsbacheloruddannelse gennem kvote 1 og 2 ved enten at supplere med enkeltfag efter samme regler som hf’erne eller tage deres IB-eksamen om for at få et IB Diploma – Retake.
